item.title: Scientists expand genetic alphabet to eight letters
item.description: UC San Diego researchers showed that a key enzyme can accurately read an eight-letter genetic alphabet, doubling the standard four-letter code.

item.title: Quantum oscillations in exotic material challenge expectations
item.description: Scientists observed unusual electron behavior in zirconium pentatelluride, a material that can act as both an insulator and a conductor.
